description: MEASUR is Oak Ridge National Laboratory's Manufacturing Energy Assessment Software for Utility Reduction. It combines equipment inventories and engineering calculations for industrial pumps, compressed air, process heating, fans, steam and wastewater systems. Users enter plant and equipment assumptions, compare proposed modifications and inspect estimated energy and financial effects. It runs as a web application or packaged desktop tool, backed by a C++ calculation library compiled to WebAssembly. Coverage is globally configurable at equipment and facility level, with no fixed observation period. Source is free under UT-Battelle's custom permissive licence, including notice, modification-attribution and name-use conditions. A limitation is uneven module maturity: water assessment is beta, process cooling is in development and several inventory modules are only planned. Calculated savings depend on user inputs and were not independently validated in this review. MEASUR can support industrial energy-retrofit simulations, complementary to system-level energy planning with PyPSA (model-pypsa). Public documentation identifies available modules and more than 80 calculators. No application installer or plant data were downloaded.
name: MEASUR industrial energy assessment
